title: Traces of Green's functions on $\mathbb{H}^q$ over point-hypersurface pairs
summary: The famous algebraicity conjecture of Gross and Zagier for the values at CM points of higher Green's functions was recently proven by Bruinier, Li and Yang. Motivated by this the values of the automorphic Green's function at pairs of special points in hyperbolic $3$-space $\mathbb{H}^3$ were studied by Herrero, Imamoglu, von Pippich and Schwagenscheidt, and an analogous algebraicity result for traces of Green's functions was established.
